signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Merit is invite-only. Accounts are created by hand — there is no sign-up.

errors.invalidCredentials: That address and password do not match an account. Check both and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.offline: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.unknown: The request did not go through. Try again.

dashboard.planned: The day's summary goes here — calories against your target, the macro split, and whether a session is due.

food.planned: Logging a food goes here — search the catalogue, scan a barcode, or enter the values by hand.

training.planned: Training goes here — your routines, the session for today, and the sets as you log them.

more.planned: Settings, data export and the legal pages go here.

preferences.label: preferences
preferences.saveFailed: That preference did not save and has been put back. Check your connection and try again.

weight.loadFailed: Your weigh-ins could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
weight.averageNote: The average is the mean of every weigh-in in the {{days}} days ending on that day. Days without one are left out, not filled in.
weight.undoFailed: That entry could not be put back. Log the day again.

chart.label: trend · kg
chart.empty: log a weight to see the trend
chart.aria: Weight in kilograms, {{entries}} weigh-ins from {{from}} to {{to}}, between {{low}} and {{high}} kg. The daily values and their seven-day average.
chart.tableCaption: Every weigh-in in the selected range, with its seven-day average.

form.label: log a weight
form.weightInvalid: Enter a weight between 20 and 400 kg, like 82.4.
form.bodyFatInvalid: Enter a percentage between 1 and 75, like 18.5, or leave it empty.
form.saveFailed: That weigh-in did not save. Check your connection and try again.
form.deleteFailed: That entry could not be deleted. Check your connection and try again.
